cards.name: The Greyhound
cards.flavor: A hound is coming that will chase the she-wolf back to Hell.
cards.art: A lean greyhound running at full speed across a hillside at dawn.

cards.name: Soul on the Shore
cards.flavor: It waits for the boat and tells you what it saw.
cards.art: A pale naked soul sitting on a grey riverbank, looking across dark water.

cards.name: Undecided Soul
cards.flavor: He never chose a side, so no side will have him.
cards.art: A pale naked man standing still on a grey plain beside a blank banner.

cards.name: Camilla, Volscian Maiden
cards.flavor: She ran over the wheat without bending a single stalk.
cards.art: A young woman with a bow sprinting across a golden wheat field.

cards.name: Socrates, the Questioner
cards.flavor: He questioned everyone until they admitted they knew nothing.
cards.art: An old bald man in a plain cloak questioning a small circle of students.

cards.name: Forese Donati
cards.text: End of Turn: Restore 1 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: A friend of the poet, still hungry, still smiling.
cards.art: A thin man with hollow cheeks smiling weakly beside a fruit tree he cannot reach.

cards.name: The Sullen
cards.flavor: They sulked in the black mud and refused to move.
cards.art: Two gaunt figures sunk to the waist in dark swamp water.

cards.name: Avaricious Weight
cards.text: On Play: Gain 1 empty mana crystal.
cards.flavor: Hoarders and spenders shove their weights at each other forever.
cards.art: A huge stone ball rolling along a cracked road between two crowds of shoving figures.

cards.name: The Phoenix
cards.flavor: It burns to ash and rises again, as the old poets said.
cards.art: A phoenix rising out of a pile of glowing ashes with its wings spread wide.

cards.name: The Great Refusal
cards.text: Start of Turn: Freeze a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He turned down the papal throne out of cowardice.
cards.art: An old man in papal robes turning his back on a golden throne.

cards.name: Electra, Mother of Troy
cards.text: Last Breath: Summon a 1/1 Shade of Limbo.
cards.flavor: Grief for her fallen city keeps her standing in the dark.
cards.art: A veiled woman with bowed head standing among broken stone columns.

cards.name: Saladin, Sultan of Egypt
cards.text: On Play: Restore 2 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Honor earned him a place among the wise, but not the gate.
cards.art: A bearded ruler in a white robe and turban seated on a carved stone throne.

cards.name: Dido, Queen of Carthage
cards.text: On Play: Silence an enemy minion.
cards.flavor: She loved too much, and the love left her with nothing.
cards.art: A queen in a long gown standing beside a burning funeral pyre on the shore.

cards.name: Helen of Troy
cards.text: On Play: Deal 2 damage to a minion.
cards.flavor: Her beauty started a war, and the blame never left her.
cards.art: A beautiful woman with long golden hair, seen from behind at a walled city gate.

cards.name: Wrathful Shade
cards.text: End of Turn: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: Angry for no reason, it strikes whoever is near.
cards.art: A figure with clenched fists rising out of dark water.

cards.name: Prodigal Weight
cards.text: On Play: Give a friendly minion +2 Attack.
cards.flavor: Spending without measure is its own kind of weight.
cards.art: A large stone weight rolling down a steep path past scattered gold coins.

cards.name: Hector of Troy
cards.flavor: The finest Trojan fighter, still defending a city that burned.
cards.art: A bearded warrior in bronze armor holding a round shield before a burning city wall.

cards.name: Penthesilea, Amazon Queen
cards.flavor: A warrior queen who fought bravely and fell to Achilles.
cards.art: A warrior woman with a crescent shield and spear riding a horse.

cards.name: Tristan
cards.flavor: He drank the love potion once and is swept along by the wind forever.
cards.art: A young knight in a torn tunic tossed by a howling wind in a dark sky.

cards.name: Filippo Argenti
cards.text: Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to all enemies.
cards.flavor: He bit his own arm in the black water, and his rage never stopped.
cards.art: A furious man in dark water biting his own forearm.

cards.name: Orpheus, the Singer
cards.text: On Play: Add 2 Shades of Limbo to your hand.
cards.flavor: When he sings, even the shades come back to listen.
cards.art: A young musician playing a lyre while pale shades gather around him in a grey meadow.

cards.name: Achilles, Swift-Footed
cards.text: Swift. Last Breath: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy minion.
cards.flavor: He could outrun anyone, but not the arrow aimed at his heel.
cards.art: A muscular warrior sprinting along a windy shore with a spear raised.

cards.name: Semiramis, Queen of Babylon
cards.text: Drain. On Play: Gain 2 empty mana crystals.
cards.flavor: She made her own desires into law.
cards.art: A crowned queen in a long gown standing on a stone throne above a city.

cards.name: Julius Caesar
cards.flavor: He crossed the Rubicon, and now he waits in the shade of Limbo.
cards.art: A Roman general in a red-trimmed cloak raising one hand.

cards.name: Avaricious Hoarder
cards.flavor: He hoarded all his life, and now he must push the weight forever.
cards.art: A heavy bald man straining to push a huge stone weight uphill.

cards.name: Thorn Jab
cards.flavor: Snap a thorn off the wood and strike.
cards.art: A broken thorny branch lying on dead leaves.

cards.name: Lost Path
cards.text: Draw a card. Restore 1 Health to your hero.
cards.flavor: Every road in the dark wood looks the same.
cards.art: A narrow dirt path disappearing into a dense forest.

cards.name: Hidden Shield
cards.flavor: Sometimes the safest place is the one nobody notices.
cards.art: A round bronze shield leaning against a stone wall in shadow.

cards.name: Turned Away at the Hill
cards.text: Return a minion to its owner's hand.
cards.flavor: Three beasts blocked the hill and drove him back down.
cards.art: A wild cat, a lion and a wolf circling a rocky hillside.

cards.name: Silencing Word
cards.flavor: One calm word, and the shouting stops.
cards.art: A finger pressed to closed lips above an open scroll.

cards.name: Bitter Chill
cards.flavor: The cold keeps it still for a full turn.
cards.art: Ice crystals spreading over dead reeds at the edge of a grey lake.

cards.name: Cup of Forgetting
cards.text: Add a Shade of Limbo to your hand.
cards.flavor: Drink, and the past slips away like a shadow.
cards.art: A plain clay cup on a stone table beside a still dark pool.

cards.name: Gale of the Lustful
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
cards.flavor: Lovers swept together by a storm that never ends.
cards.art: A violent wind over a rough sea with many figures carried along.

cards.name: Hoarded Coin
cards.flavor: Gold you cannot spend is still gold.
cards.art: A single gold coin lying on a dark stone floor.

cards.name: Cut the Thread
cards.flavor: Someone has to cut the thread, even in Hell.
cards.art: Heavy iron shears cutting a long white thread.

cards.name: Shade of Limbo
cards.flavor: A pale shape that remembers nothing of its life.
cards.art: A pale translucent human silhouette drifting above grey stones.
